description: A dark purple T-shirt lies on a light green bed sheet, with a charging cable off to the left and a brown headboard or cushion behind. The right hand reaches in to grab the shirt and lift it while the left hand comes in to help, then both hands stretch it flat and lay it down; the left hand folds one side inward and smooths it, the right hand folds the other side over to form a long rectangle, and finally the right hand folds that rectangle up into a compact square and releases it onto the bed.
